name: Filigree Vector
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each of any number of target creatures and a charge counter on each of any number of target artifacts.
{1}, {T}, Sacrifice another artifact: Proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each of any number of target creatures and a charge counter on each of any number of target artifacts.

needs.what: one ability declaring two independent caster-sized target specs ('any number of target creatures' and 'any number of target artifacts'), where an artifact creature may be chosen as a target of both specs and each spec's refs stay distinguishable on resolution
needs.why_existing_wont_do: A target spec's count may be "any", but the loader (loader.targets, TargetSpec.count) admits at most one variable-size spec per ability and requires it to be last, because filter_legal slices stored refs spec by spec. Splitting the sentence into two triggered abilities would create two triggers instead of one; a single spec with any_types [Creature, Artifact] cannot say which counter an artifact creature gets, nor let it be targeted for both.
